test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A thief escapes custody at 10 a.m. He runs at a speed of 40 km/h. The policeman starts chasing the thief at 11:30 a.m., starting from the point from where the thief escaped custody. The speed of the policeman is 60 km/h. At what time will he catch the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

A thief escapes custody at 10 a.m. He runs at a speed of 40 km/h. 

The policeman starts chasing the thief at 11:30 a.m.

The speed of the policeman is 60 km/h.

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time
